subject: extn
title: EXTN.-----SOC.RT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 318 (R(AS)CM(I)-2). EXTN (existentialism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: PART (participation) and IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism). From PART: OP-SD (option spread) and INDIV-DY (individual dynamics). From IST-F-AT: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and VT-ATT (vibrational attitude). From INDIV-DY: AF-TD (affinity tendencies). From APP-RDEF: V-SY (value system). From VT-ATT: OBS (observation).
